intro: I collaborate with engineering leaders, applied science teams, and data organizations to build resilient data platforms and production machine learning systems that run within strict latency and accuracy SLAs.

items.title: Production ML & Predictive Systems
items.short: High-throughput, calibrated machine learning models designed for real-time inference.
items.description: End-to-end design and deployment of machine learning architectures for fraud detection, ranking, and predictive telemetry. Specializing in probability calibration, loss surface design, and sub-20ms inference pipelines.
deliverables: Problem formulation, loss function alignment & statistical baseline
Feature engineering pipeline with zero training-serving skew
Model training, cross-validation & quantization (ONNX / TensorRT)
Production serving endpoint with automated data drift observability
items.bestFor: Teams needing high-reliability ML models running under strict production latency constraints.

items.title: Distributed Data Engines & Streaming
items.short: Real-time event streaming and scalable Lakehouse data platforms.
items.description: Architecting distributed streaming and batch pipelines using Apache Spark, Kafka, and DuckDB. Eliminating data bottlenecks, establishing strict schema contracts, and delivering clean, low-latency features.
deliverables: High-throughput Kafka streaming pipelines (100k+ events/sec)
PySpark and DuckDB query optimization & partition tuning
Delta Lake / Iceberg storage tables with ACID guarantees
dbt data modeling, semantic layers & automated freshness assertions
items.bestFor: Enterprises handling large volumes of streaming events that need sub-second freshness.

items.title: MLOps Infrastructure & Model Serving
items.short: Robust model registries, serving clusters, and automated continuous evaluation.
items.description: Building infrastructure that transitions models from research notebooks to battle-tested microservices with Ray Serve, Triton Inference Server, and Kubernetes.
deliverables: Containerized inference microservices with Ray & Triton
Automated CI/CD pipelines for model validation & regression gates
Real-time feature store integration (Feast / Hopsworks)
Telemetry dashboards tracking latency percentiles & concept drift
items.bestFor: Teams scaling machine learning from isolated prototypes to multi-cluster production environments.

items.title: Vector Search & LLM Retrieval Systems
items.short: Domain-specific hybrid retrieval systems and low-latency semantic search.
items.description: Architecting enterprise-grade vector search and RAG platforms that deliver factual, hallucination-resistant retrieval over multi-million document corpora.
deliverables: Hybrid lexical + dense retrieval pipelines (BM25 + embeddings)
Chunking strategies and fine-tuned domain embedding models
Cross-encoder reranking layers and semantic query caching
Retrieval latency and recall benchmarking suites
items.bestFor: Organizations building intelligent knowledge engines, semantic search, or LLM-powered systems.

items.title: Statistical Inference & Experimentation
items.short: Principled hypothesis testing, causal inference, and A/B test analysis.
items.description: Designing experimental frameworks that measure true incremental lift. Moving beyond naive p-values to Bayesian inference, variance reduction, and sequential testing.
deliverables: Experiment design, sample sizing & minimum detectable effect power
CUPED variance reduction framework implementation
Causal inference & synthetic control modeling for observational data
Decision boundary automation and guardrail metric monitors
items.bestFor: Product and growth organizations seeking statistical certainty in core metrics.

items.title: Data & ML Platform Audits
items.short: Comprehensive technical review of data pipelines and model inference clusters.
items.description: Deep architectural reviews of existing pipelines, database queries, and model serving infrastructure. Identifying latency bottlenecks, training-serving discrepancies, and compute cost inefficiencies.
deliverables: End-to-end pipeline latency profiling and bottleneck analysis
Cloud compute cost optimization roadmap (typically 25-45% reduction)
Data contract and schema validation integrity audit
Prioritized engineering backlog with code benchmarks
items.bestFor: Engineering leaders preparing for scale or seeking to reduce cloud compute costs.

process.title: Discover & Profile
process.description: We audit the data landscape, inspect schema definitions, and profile system constraints. I align technical objectives with measurable business criteria.

process.title: Architect & Formalize
process.description: We establish strict schema contracts, loss surfaces, and latency targets. Clear benchmarks are agreed upon before building pipelines.

process.title: Engineer & Validate
process.description: Pipelines and models are built iteratively with automated unit tests, cross-validation, and integration benchmarks under simulated production load.

process.title: Optimize & Harden
process.description: We apply kernel optimizations, weight quantization, connection pooling, and stress-test failover mechanisms.

process.title: Deploy & Telemetry
process.description: We release via canary or shadow mode with live drift monitoring, latency dashboards, and full operational runbooks.

faqs.question: What does a typical engagement look like?
faqs.answer: Engagements typically range from six to twelve weeks for platform architecture or model deployment. I integrate closely with your data engineering or platform team, participating in sprints and conducting technical reviews.

faqs.question: How do you prevent training-serving skew?
faqs.answer: I enforce shared feature definitions between offline training jobs and online streaming pipelines using declarative feature stores (e.g., Feast), immutable artifact registries, and strict schema contracts.

faqs.question: Can you work with our existing cloud stack?
faqs.answer: Yes. I have extensive experience across AWS (EMR, Kinesis, S3, SageMaker), GCP (BigQuery, Vertex, Dataflow), and on-premise Kubernetes clusters running Spark, Kafka, and Triton.

faqs.question: Do you provide code, infrastructure, or advisory?
faqs.answer: All three. Engagements yield production-ready, thoroughly tested Python/SQL/C++ code, declarative Terraform/Helm infrastructure recipes, and comprehensive architectural documentation.

faqs.question: How do you evaluate model performance beyond offline metrics?
faqs.answer: Offline AUC/F1 is only the first checkpoint. I design comprehensive evaluation suites including calibration plots, slicing analysis across subgroups, stress tests with synthetic outliers, and online A/B experimentation frameworks.
